verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs describe an official MCP Server that connects meeting data to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI chat tools. It covers transcript search across all time periods, transcripts and action items, and recaps, with OAuth authentication and granular per-meeting authorization. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, detailed setup/tool reference docs, and clarity on plan availability (sources frame it under Otter for Enterprise).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official MCP server lets Claude or any MCP client query my meetings — search, transcripts, action items — with OAuth, no glue code

citations.quote: Otter's MCP Server connects your meeting data directly to AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, bringing your meeting intelligence into your everyday AI workflows.
Connect Otter.ai meeting transcripts and action items to Claude via MCP. Search, recap, and draft follow-ups without leaving the chat.
ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI chat tools can securely access your meeting knowledge through Otter's MCP Server
Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods
OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions. Your AI assistant can only access meetings you explicitly authorize
